vanilla_changes.change: Piglins, Piglin Brutes and Hoglins are not converted to their zombified form in the Overworld unless affected by Weakness, which makes them shake and convert as normal.

editor_notes: Server-side only; requires Collective. Useful for bringing piglins home or trading in the Overworld.
name: Overworld Piglins
summary: Piglins, Piglin Brutes and Hoglins no longer shake and turn into zombified versions in the Overworld. They only convert if they have the Weakness effect.
